title: Temporal Sequencing in Warfare: mihelyt, amint, miután

sections.title: Narrating Chains of Strategic Victories and Treaties
sections.content: You know time clauses with *amint* and *miután* from earlier units. Narrating a long campaign, they link its stages: *amint / mihelyt* ('as soon as'), *miután* ('after') and *végül* ('in the end').

items.spanish: Amint Buda felszabadult, a császári hadak dél felé nyomultak előre.
items.english: As soon as Buda was liberated, the imperial armies advanced southward.

items.spanish: Miután Savoyai Jenő Zentánál döntő vereséget mért a török seregre, a törökök békét kértek.
items.english: After Eugene of Savoy dealt the Turkish army a decisive defeat at Zenta, the Turks asked for peace.

items.spanish: Az 1699-es karlócai békével végleg lezárult a 150 éves oszmán hódoltság korszaka.
items.english: With the 1699 Peace of Karlowitz, the 150-year era of Ottoman rule came to a permanent close.
